mapper.sql: v.id, v.student_id, v.building, v.room_no, v.inspection_id, v.late_id, v.type, v.occurred_at, v.detail, v.rule_ref, v.advice, v.handling, v.counselor_id, v.handled_by, v.handled_at, v.result_note, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, p.student_no AS student_no, p.class_name AS class_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(cs.real_name, ''), cs.nickname, cs.username) AS counselor_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(hb.real_name, ''), hb.nickname, hb.username) AS handled_by_name

FROM community_violation v LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = v.student_id LEFT JOIN student_profile p ON p.user_id = v.student_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users cs ON cs.id = v.counselor_id LEFT JOIN users hb ON hb.id = v.handled_by

sql.if: AND (v.detail LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.rule_ref LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_violation (student_id, building, room_no, inspection_id, late_id, type, occurred_at, detail, rule_ref, advice, handling, counselor_id, handled_by, handled_at, result_note, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{building}, #{roomNo}, #{inspectionId}, #{lateId}, #{type}, #{occurredAt}, #{detail}, #{ruleRef}, #{advice}, #{handling}, #{counselorId}, #{handledBy}, #{handledAt}, #{resultNote}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE community_violation SET building = #{violation.building}, room_no = #{violation.roomNo}, type = #{violation.type}, occurred_at = #{violation.occurredAt}, detail = #{violation.detail}, rule_ref = #{violation.ruleRef}, advice = #{violation.advice}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{violation.id} AND deleted = 0 AND handling = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE community_violation SET handling = #{handling}, result_note = #{resultNote}, handled_by = #{handledBy}, handled_at = #{handledAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND handling = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select:
SELECT v.type AS type, COUNT(*) AS total FROM community_violation v WHERE v.deleted = 0
GROUP BY v.type ORDER BY v.type

SELECT v.advice AS advice, COUNT(*) AS total FROM community_violation v WHERE v.deleted = 0
GROUP BY v.advice ORDER BY v.advice

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN v.handling = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN v.handling = 'notified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS notified, SUM(CASE WHEN v.handling = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed, SUM(CASE WHEN v.advice = 'education' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS education, SUM(CASE WHEN v.advice = 'circulated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS circulated, SUM(CASE WHEN v.advice = 'warning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warning, SUM(CASE WHEN v.advice = 'serious_warning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serious_warning, SUM(CASE WHEN v.advice = 'recorded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recorded FROM community_violation v WHERE v.deleted = 0
